_doc: The container control of Config > Sources (above Cloud-Fincept): Start / Stop / Restart of the FinceptTerminal container through c3-infra-api, over the PRIVATE MESH ONLY. The base address is the fleet endpoint `api.fleet_endpoint` (ac_cloud-account/build.json::fleet_endpoints, mesh_dns:mesh_port, baked into FLEET_MESH_B64 by app/build.gradle); on the mesh the connection is WireGuard-authenticated, so no bearer is sent (the public c3-pvt route would need the Authelia bearer and is deliberately not used). Off the mesh the control is disabled and says so. Status is read from api.status_path (docker ps status text of the VM's containers).
